description: Adds reversible archival to content records without deleting or moving data.
legacyCompatibility: Missing recordStatus is returned as Active. No bulk backfill is required; subsequent edits persist the default.
mutation: Existing authenticated PATCH routes validate and persist recordStatus using normal edit permissions and ETag protection.
gridBehavior: Active-only by default. Mutually exclusive Active/Archived choices appear in the toolbar dropdown's Status pane, beside its Actions pane; the Status column precedes row actions.
retention: Archiving preserves descendants, page order, ownership, and quota usage. It does not cascade status changes. DELETE still permanently removes the record and its scoped descendants.
